notes: Attachment read-back: session messages now carry attachment metadata and the host serves the bytes via authenticated GET /sessions/{id}/attachments/{attachmentId} (session-scoped refs; images inline, files as downloads). The phone renders historical file/image chips, downloads with a 25 MB cap into the app cache and opens them through FileProvider with a share fallback. Includes a raw HTTP response carrier for byte routes and fake-host attachment fixtures/tests (7 checks).
